thresholds.meaning: Maximum age for active feed deals; observations older than 24h are categorized as historical.
thresholds.source_evidence: Airfare volatility research: dynamic pricing resets daily at minimum.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Guarantees that active feed does not present day-old fares as live.
thresholds.review_trigger: Feedback on expired fare rates or API update interval change.

thresholds.meaning: Confidence floor below which deal claims are strictly capped (no strong deal labels allowed).
thresholds.source_evidence: Golden dataset case 12: high discount with 1 sample must not trigger aggressive buy recommendation.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Prevents false-positive buy recommendations on sparse data.
thresholds.review_trigger: Expansion to new low-frequency long-haul routes.

thresholds.meaning: Confidence threshold required for Deal cực nóng label.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Limits top urgency language to well-sampled routes.

thresholds.meaning: Confidence threshold required for Deal rất ngon label.
thresholds.claim_ceiling: Limits second-tier urgency language to verified cohorts.

thresholds.meaning: Deal score threshold for Deal cực nóng.
thresholds.source_evidence: Scores >= 90 represent top 5th percentile price + high freshness + direct flight.

thresholds.meaning: Deal score threshold for Deal rất ngon.
thresholds.source_evidence: Scores >= 80 represent >= 20% discount with solid cohort support.

thresholds.meaning: Deal score threshold for Deal ngon.
thresholds.source_evidence: Scores >= 70 represent notable discount relative to median.

thresholds.meaning: Deal score threshold for Giá đáng chú ý.
thresholds.source_evidence: Scores >= 60 represent slightly below average prices or interesting routes.

thresholds.meaning: Minimum observations required before median baseline and percentile can be computed.
thresholds.source_evidence: Statistical rule: median of sample size < 3 is degenerate.

thresholds.meaning: Cohort sample count required to achieve 100% confidence score.
thresholds.source_evidence: 12 observations cover multiple departure windows across comparable carriers.

thresholds.meaning: Bounded backoff intervals for failed notification delivery.
thresholds.source_evidence: RFC exponential backoff standard adapted for transactional email/push.
